tool.name: decision_evaluate
tool.label: Decision evaluation
tool.description: Evaluate only supplied state with this agent's selected decision model. Ask independent boolean (explicit answer and/or probabilityTrue), choice (competing alternatives), or score (fractional zero-based rubric position) questions. Use contractVersion 2 and tagged state for images, box (normalized image edges), sort (list IDs), or tags, when the provider supports them. A box does not prove presence; ask a companion boolean question. Instructions and criteria accept text, JSON objects/arrays, or null, except box instructions must be non-null. Preserve explicit answers, abstentions, per-question errors, distributions, metadata and usage; never infer missing probabilities or normalize estimates. Optional confidence is not demonstrated accuracy. Dependent questions require another call with the previous result explicitly supplied. Sends no ambient conversation or files. Hosted providers may charge. Results never authorize actions. The selected provider supports boolean, choice, score, sort, tags, box questions. Supported input modalities: text, json, image, list. Limits: images up to 4194304 decoded bytes in image/png, image/jpeg, at most 400 questions, at least 2 Choice alternatives, at most 255 Choice alternatives, at least 2 Score levels, at most 10 Score levels, at most 10000 tokens per request, at most 8000 tokens per state-plus-question, at most 5000 tokens per encoded question (state and rubric together); shorten state or rubric if exceeded. Boolean questions require both criteria.true and criteria.false descriptions. Optional confidence is a provider-specific distribution metric, not correctness probability.

limits: Complete unchanged decision tool factory, contract, V1/V2 validators/compatibility, text-result and model-setting/ref helpers execute with actual TypeBox1.3.37.

The synthetic decision runtime evaluate/complete facade records invocation data, callback order and supplied successful outcome; original provider-host/runtime/billing/authority bodies are not executed.

Runtime configuration, Agent lookup, metadata snapshot, available manifests and current plugin registry are explicit input facades. Actual settings resolver runs against those inputs, not full configuration inheritance or plugin eligibility services.

Only positive selected/configured factory and successful callback cases execute. All six generic result kinds, supplied evidence, estimates/abstentions/metadata/usage and complete JSON content/details are retained.

No real provider/network/account, registration/assembly, disabled/invalid/error/cancellation/security/permission behavior is exercised. Synthetic model capability declarations do not establish actual provider support.

Reference rubric uses decision-v1 while Synapsis deliberately uses synapsis-decision-v1 semantic-map canonicalization; this capture does not change the accepted host adaptation or whole-reference gates.
